metadata.title: South Asian Regional Visa Regimes & Mobility Index

freedom_of_movement.label: Freedom of Movement
freedom_of_movement.description: Unrestricted entry and residence rights without visa; citizen identity card accepted; right to live, work, and own property with reciprocal national treatment.

visa_free_voa.label: Visa-Free / Free VoA
visa_free_voa.description: Zero consular visa required prior to departure; free or nominal Visa-on-Arrival at international ports of entry for tourist or general travel.

concessionary_eta.label: Concessionary ETA / eVisa
concessionary_eta.description: Online Electronic Travel Authorization (ETA) or pre-arrival registration with discounted regional SAARC fees (e.g. 50-60% off non-regional rates).

consular_visa.label: Standard Consular Visa
consular_visa.description: Traditional passport visa required prior to departure via embassy or high commission; standard documentation and processing times apply.

restricted_prior_approval.label: Restricted / Security Vetting
restricted_prior_approval.description: Stringent clearance, designated entry/exit checkpoints, city-specific endorsements, multi-agency vetting, or mandatory Police Reporting (PRS).
